traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Caryocaraceae: leaves alternate or opposite; leaves compound; compound leaves pinnate; margins entire, serrate or dentate; veins palmate; leaves evergreen; stipules present or absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup present or absent; stems woody; flowers in racemes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit drupe; stamens 50 to 200; carpels 4 to 20. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
